{"action":"edit","path":"toolformer_filter.py","old_text":"","new_text":"import numpy as np
from typing import Tuple

def filter_api_calls(
    log_probs_with_call_and_result: np.ndarray,
    log_probs_with_call_only: np.ndarray,
    log_probs_without_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [
        (log_probs_with_call_and_result, "log_probs_with_call_and_result"),
        (log_probs_with_call_only, "log_probs_with_call_only"),
        (log_probs_without_call, "log_probs_without_call"),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not contain positive values")
    
    # Check shape consistency
    shape = log_probs_with_call_and_result.shape
    if log_probs_with_call_only.shape != shape or log_probs_without_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    
    # Compute weighted losses
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * log_probs_with_call_and_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * log_probs_with_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(normalized_weights * log_probs_without_call, axis=1)
    
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    
    # Margin and keep mask
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep_mask, margin"}
